author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev (Final Corrected): Unit Test for Harness v2.1
abstract: Third and final attempt to validate the new harness. This submission tests `logos_harness_v2.1`, which restores missing distribution logic. The test script is also corrected to use a large `scale` parameter, guaranteeing that the new `clamp_factor` functionality is rigorously tested. A successful run will finally validate the tool for Project Fulcrum.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
command = ["python", "-m", "unittest", "storage/logos/test_harness_v2_logic.py"]
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError("Unit test failed a third time.")
